_about: Notes for translators of en.json. Not loaded by the app. Placeholders in {braces} must stay as they are; plural keys end in _one/_other (add _few, _many and so on only where your language needs them).
status.restingUntil: {time} is a clock time, already formatted for the reader's language (for example 14:32 or 2:32 PM). It is not a duration. Shown as a status label next to a coloured dot.
status.nextIn: {time} is a countdown in minutes and seconds (for example 1:26), not a clock time.
away.since: {time} is a clock time (for example 10:41), or a date and time when it was more than about a day ago.
status.blocked: Status label: the character cannot take turns right now (no AI engine ready, game server unreachable, key refused). The reason is shown on the next line. Not 'blocked by another player'. Keep it short: it sits in a one-line status row.
char.forget: Button. Removes the character from this device only: the character stays in the game world, keeps its progress, and other people still see it. This app just stops playing it. Must not suggest deleting the character from the game.
forget.confirm: Same meaning as char.forget, on the confirmation button.
tab.guidance: Tab name, short (four tabs share a 360 px wide phone screen). The tab holds how the character should behave: its private persona, a standing wish, how often it plays, whether it may fight other players, and a one-time command.
new.bio: Public text about the character, visible to everyone. Contrast with new.persona, which is private.
new.persona: Private description that only guides the AI on this device.
new.bioCount: {n} is the number of characters typed so far; 300 is the maximum.
log.thought: Follows the character's name: 'Pip thinks: <what the AI was thinking>'.
card.latestA11y: Screen-reader label for the latest-news line of a card. {ago} is a relative time from the system ("2 minutes ago"); {text} is the game's own narration.
nudge.quest: A command the owner can edit and send to the character. {quest} is a quest id or name from the game (not translated); {step} is the step text from the game.
nudge.turnIn: Same as nudge.quest: a suggested command. {quest} comes from the game.
stuck.label: Short chip on a character card when its recent turns look like a loop or keep being refused. Neutral, not alarming.
talk.modeCommand: A one-time instruction the character reads on its next turn (it may still choose how). Contrast with talk.modeChat, which only gets a reply.
status.thinkingFor: Follows the "Thinking" status: {time} is a duration in minutes and seconds (1:32), how long the AI has been working on this turn.
slow.title: {time} is a duration in minutes and seconds. Shown when the AI engine has not answered a turn for a long time.
time.justNow: Replaces a relative time ("2 minutes ago") for anything under ten seconds old, or stamped slightly in the future by clock skew. Never word it as a future time.
stuck.no_progress: Reason shown under "Seems stuck": several turns with nothing gained.
stuck.lost: Reason shown under "Seems stuck": the character cannot find the place its quest needs.
nudge.lost: A suggested command the owner can edit and send. "Mistvale Square" is a place name from the game; keep it as the game names it in your language if the game translates it.
new.languageHint: Under the language choice on New character. The game narrates in this language, and the character speaks and thinks (its visible thoughts) in it.
new.personaHint: Translate the example in quotes as a sentence an owner would actually type in your language; the AI reads the persona in any language.
guide.personaHint: Same example as new.personaHint, translated the same way.
settings.keepAwake: Applies to computers (no sleep) and phones (screen stays on). Device-neutral wording.
engine.verifying: Phone only: after the 1.1 GB download, the file is checked against a pinned checksum. {percent} is 0 to 100.
